Why You Can't Cancel Your Subscriptions ($1,200 Reason)
youtube_short.description: That 'cancel anytime' button is a lie — companies pay UX designers specifically to hide the cancel option 7 screens deep so you give up and keep paying. The FTC documented $1.2 billion in consumer harm from this one dark pattern. You've got 4 forgotten subscriptions averaging $25/month each — that's $1,200 a year quietly draining out. Here's the one move that stops it: open your bank statement, find every recurring charge, and cancel the ones you haven't used this month. That's $1,200 back every year. Follow for more money traps. #personalfinance #money #subscriptions #moneytips #savemoney
